headline: Moody's Affirms France's Aa3 Rating with Negative Outlook
summary: Moody's Ratings maintained France's sovereign credit rating at Aa3 while keeping its negative outlook unchanged.
why: Sovereign credit ratings influence government borrowing costs and benchmark bond yields across European debt capital markets.

impacts.name: France
impacts.why: Maintaining a negative outlook signals ongoing risks of a potential future sovereign downgrade if fiscal deficits persist.
